info.name: State Bank — Mini Banking & Open Banking API
info.description:
Run the folders in order (Collection Runner). Folder 02 gets a token for each role; later requests reuse them.
Requires the stack from docker-compose (http://localhost:8080) and the demo users imported from keycloak/bank-management-realm.json.
